svg.text: A design reference we can edit together
The boards reproduce the implemented app, with native phone chrome and a 390 px content width.
Long boards show the complete scrollable content. Web uses the same centered column (max 768
px), hides the Home scanner, and shows a phone-only scanning message.
Every title, label, button, card, calendar cell, QR module, and icon is editable. Hangboard
pictures and the gameplay still reuse bundled app assets. The font weights are installed in
History, dates, grades, and session notes are representative design fixtures. Camera preview is
schematic. The video still represents the local playback surface. OS permission prompts and
keyboard UI are supplied by the platform.
Main action hotspots connect representative states. Cross-page links open the destination in
another Penpot preview tab. This design prototype does not run a live countdown, save workouts,
or scan QR codes. Use the app for behavior testing.
Duplicate a board before exploring a change. Keep reviewed editable exports in design/penpot
and review images in design/exports. MoonBoard remains a separate exploration; this recreation
does not expand the app scope.
